name: HollowNeRF
definition: A NeRF compression method that automatically sparsifies the feature grid during training by using a trainable 3D saliency mask to guide efficient feature pruning, redistributing hash collisions to improve rendering quality with fewer parameters.
summary: HollowNeRF compresses NeRFs by using a trainable 3D saliency mask to prune features in empty regions during training, unlike static pruning methods.
